scope: Finite full-data development transfer study on two previously examined seeds per environment; not fresh confirmation or a replacement for five-seed formal results.
inputs: Graph/Simple: all h3 raw prediction-difference coordinates; MIF: all original rich horizon/entity endpoint+edge coordinates, including repaired MaMuJoCo endpoints. No restriction to an advantageous outcome entity.
objective: Full-visibility value-space MSE + original variance floor + .02 off-diagonal covariance. This common-objective diagnostic variant is explicitly different from historical formal training. Fixed final representation checkpoint; no result-based selection.
contrast: Within model, raw replaces ONLY Mobius/zeta buffers by identity. Same parameter initialization, allocated parameters, batches, optimizer, update count and normalizer. MIF axes/readout unchanged. Graph complement permutes reference masks within the same event before subtraction; it intentionally changes the edge-only signal, not claimed equal information.
normalization: Fit per-feature statistics on valid training observation tables only. Raw and matched share identical statistics. Complement fits its own training signal scale; that is part of the signal intervention, not an isolated equal-information matching comparison.
history: Unmodified existing GRU trainers, 1200 updates, existing observation-only dev selection. No new semantic loss in this cohort. Check fixed-decoder parity and edge/interaction reconstruction before and after history prediction.
grounding: Unmodified existing grounding, same fixed Base, same fit/validation prefixes, original action budgets and all 100 MPE / 50 MaMuJoCo evaluation seeds. No additional decoder normalization or objective change.
references: All ten named original configurations reused only after exact evaluation-seed, budget, split/source and result integrity checks. Repaired MaMuJoCo Graph/Simple/MIF routed explicitly. Not resource-matched atomic controls, not newly trained independent samples.
primary: For Graph, Simple and MIF separately: matched minus raw mean return across ALL budgets within each training seed. Two development seeds: descriptive paired differences, no confirmatory p-value claim.
secondary: Graph matched minus within-event partner-complement; per-budget validation action MSE and native metrics; learned edge/coefficient readout at representation and history stages. Learned targets are not simulator/physical agent contributions.
information_boundary: No native labels/rewards, simulator queries or action-bearing original datasets in pretraining. Explicit numeric-artifact allowlists. All 28 representations/history policies freeze before any new grounding. Labels never tune representations.
